name: Escape Room Operations
audience: independent escape-room venues and small multi-room operators
topic: room resets and group arrival readiness for escape rooms

products.name: Escape Room Reset Check
products.product: A focused escape room reset verification workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent escape-room venues and small multi-room operators
products.problem: High-volume turnovers depend on memory for props, locks, electronics, consumables, clue states, and damage exceptions.
products.valueProposition: Turns escape room reset verification into a visible operating queue so every room is released only after a second verifiable reset check or an explicit attraction closure.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets escape room reset verification software, escape room reset verification tracker, escape room reset verification template, and escape room reset verification checklist searches.

products.name: Group Arrival Readiness
products.product: A focused escape room group arrival and waiver readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent escape-room venues and small multi-room operators
products.problem: Headcount, minors, waivers, room choice, language needs, accessibility notes, lateness, and payment changes converge at check-in.
products.valueProposition: Turns escape room group arrival and waiver readiness into a visible operating queue so every group starts with current attendance, required acknowledgments, payment state, and briefing needs confirmed.
